name: Open Notebook v1 AI Research Assistant
description: Private NotebookLM alternative: chat with your sources, generate podcasts.

PORT.description: Port of the Next.js frontend, which also proxies /api/* to the internal API (5055). Railway routes the domain and the healthcheck here.

API_URL.description: Public URL the browser uses for API calls (same origin, proxied by the frontend). Update it if you add a custom domain.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed to call the API cross-origin (upstream default is *). Add your custom domain here if you use one.

OPEN_NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD.description: Password for the web UI, also the REST API bearer token. Generated at deploy; empty disables authentication entirely.

OPEN_NOTEBOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts AI provider credentials stored in the database. Required; changing it makes saved credentials unreadable.

SURREAL_URL.description: SurrealDB WebSocket endpoint on the private network.

SURREAL_USER.description: SurrealDB root user (from the SurrealDB service).

SURREAL_PASSWORD.description: SurrealDB root password (from the SurrealDB service).

SURREAL_NAMESPACE.description: SurrealDB namespace used by Open Notebook.

SURREAL_DATABASE.description: SurrealDB database used by Open Notebook.

OPEN_NOTEBOOK_WORKER_MAX_TASKS.description: Background tasks (source processing, embeddings, podcasts) the worker runs at once (upstream default 5). Use 1 for strict provider rate limits.

OPEN_NOTEBOOK_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB.description: Largest upload the API accepts, in MB (upstream default 100).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period on redeploy so the worker can finish or release running tasks.

PORT.description: Port SurrealDB listens on (HTTP + WebSocket RPC). Used by the healthcheck and by Open Notebook.

SURREAL_USER.description: Root user created on first start. Generated at deploy.

SURREAL_PASS.description: Root password created on first start. Generated at deploy.

SURREAL_BIND.description: Listen address: all IPv6 and IPv4 interfaces on the private network (no public domain).

SURREAL_PATH.description: Storage engine and data path on the /data volume (RocksDB, as in upstream's docker-compose).

SURREAL_EXPERIMENTAL_GRAPHQL.description: Same setting as upstream Open Notebook's docker-compose.

SURREAL_NO_BANNER.description: Skip the ASCII banner in the logs.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so SurrealDB can write the root-owned Railway volume (the image's default user is 65532).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Lets SurrealDB flush RocksDB and shut down cleanly on redeploy.
